description: Temporal vessel angle describes the angular spread of the major temporal retinal vessels. Calculated as the angle between the dominant superior and inferior temporal retinal arterial vessels on concentric circles centered on the optic disc. Reported as the median across valid measurement circles. Computed on the full image.

Temporal vessel angle describes the angular spread of the major temporal retinal vessels. Retinal vessel bifurcation angle describes the opening between two daughter vessels at a branch point. Calculated as the angle between the outgoing branches of each eligible retinal arterial bifurcation. Reported as the mean across eligible bifurcations. Computed in the full region of a cropped circular grid centered nine-tenths of the way from the optic disc to the fovea, with radius equal to nine-tenths of their separation plus the optic-disc radius.

display_name: Distance Tortuosity Circle - A (max segment len=0.2)
description: Retinal vessel tortuosity describes the degree to which vessels deviate from a straight course. Higher values indicate more tortuous vessels. Calculated for retinal arterial vessel segments as path length divided by the straight-line distance between endpoints. Reported as the mean across eligible vessel segments, weighted by vessel length. Computed in the full region of a cropped circular grid centered nine-tenths of the way from the optic disc to the fovea, with radius equal to nine-tenths of their separation plus the optic-disc radius.

Fundus luminance describes the overall brightness of the retinal image. Higher values indicate a brighter image. Calculated by converting the fundus image to luminance. Reported as the mean across the visible retinal area. Computed on the full image.

Artery-vein ratio compares the arterial and venous values of the same measurement. Calculated as `temporal_cre_arteries` / `temporal_cre_veins`. Missing inputs or a zero denominator give a missing result. Computed on the full image.
